package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for sprintf_for_simple_string_format: `fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", a, b)` where only `%s` verbs are used
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario642Positive(firstName, lastName string) string {
	greeting := fmt.Sprintf("Hello %s %s, welcome back!", firstName, lastName)
	return greeting
}
